pages.title: Dark Walker
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Boots$(br2)§lEffect: §r Does not trigger sculk sensors or shriekers, produces no vibrations, and cannot be detected by Wardens. Conflicts with Swift Sneak.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Structure Loot Chests
